# IAssetAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IAssetAdapter.sol)

**Title:**
IAssetAdapter

Interface for bridge adapters that can transfer assets across chains

This interface defines methods for asset transfers only


## Functions
### transferAsset

Transfer an asset to a destination chain

Initiates a cross-chain asset transfer


```solidity
function transferAsset(
    bytes32 operationId,
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Router-provided operation ID for tracking|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams`|Parameters for the transfer|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|


### supportsAssetTransfer

Check if the adapter supports asset transfers to a specific chain


```solidity
function supportsAssetTransfer(uint16 destinationChainId, address asset) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination chain|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the asset to transfer|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|Whether asset transfers are supported|


## Events
### TransferInitiated
Emitted when a transfer is initiated through the adapter


```solidity
event TransferInitiated(
    bytes32 indexed transferId, uint16 destinationChainId, address asset, uint256 amount, address recipient
);
```

### TransferReceived
Emitted when a transfer is received through the adapter


```solidity
event TransferReceived(bytes32 indexed transferId, address asset, uint256 amount, address recipient);
```

## Errors
### TransferFailed
Thrown when a transfer operation fails


```solidity
error TransferFailed();
```
